reference_implementations.title: Effective Neural Topic Modeling with Embedding Clustering Regularization
reference_implementations.tldr: A novel neural topic model, ECRTM, addresses topic collapsing by introducing embedding clustering regularization, which ensures distinct word semantics in each topic, leading to high-quality topic distributions and better performance in classification tasks.

reference_implementations.title: Is Neural Topic Modelling Better than Clustering? An Empirical Study on Clustering with Contextual Embeddings for Topics
reference_implementations.tldr: Direct clustering of high-quality sentence embeddings with a word selecting method generates more coherent and diverse topics than neural topic models, with higher efficiency and simplicity.
